title: AnalysisRequest
description: Input to a pure engine analysis: (snapshot_id, AnalysisRequest) -> AnalysisResult. SPEC §4, §7, §8.

request_id.description: Client-generated id (UUID); becomes the TestLogEntry id.

analysis_id.description: Open enum of analysis identifiers, dotted snake_case (family.variant). The engine's registry is authoritative.

snapshot_id.description: DatasetMeta.snapshot_id the request was built against; the engine rejects a stale snapshot.

variables.description: Analysis role -> variable names. Role keys are analysis-specific snake_case (outcome, group, time, subject_id, covariates, predictors, items, x, y, ...). Always arrays for uniform typing.

subset.description: Row conditions ANDed together (e.g. Time in ['Post']). Empty = all rows.

options.description: Analysis-specific options (e.g. {"welch": true, "posthoc": "games_howell", "test_value": 3}). Per-analysis subschemas may be added later under $defs.

corrections.description: Within-analysis p-value adjustments requested (e.g. pairwise comparisons, correlation matrices). Cross-analysis family corrections live in the Test Log, never here.

Tails.title: Tails
Tails.description: two_sided is the default (SPEC §3). greater/less are one-tailed alternatives.

scope.description: Which set of p-values within this analysis, e.g. 'pairwise', 'matrix', 'simple_effects'.
